project_structure_examples.overview: Reference project structures derived from real ACE projects in this workspace. All client-specific names have been replaced with generic equivalents. Use these as templates for creating new ACE projects.

structure.name: Service_App_with_Shared_Lib
structure.description: The most common pattern: a deployable Application project that references a shared Library project. The Library contains reusable subflows, ESQL procedures, and Java utilities. The Application contains the service-specific message flows.

structure.name: WSDL_Service_Project
structure.description: A WSDL-driven service project generated from a WSDL definition. ACE generates message flows, ESQL, and handler subflows automatically. Custom logic is added by modifying the generated ESQL.

notes.note: The gen/ directory is generated — add custom logic to the ESQL files, not to the .msgflow (which may be regenerated).
The CatchHandler, FailureHandler, and HTTPTimeoutHandler subflows handle errors from the input node — always connect to a shared error handler subflow.

structure.name: Gateway_Proxy_Service
structure.description: A gateway/proxy service that routes requests to backend services based on a routing table. Uses SHARED ROW caching to avoid repeated DB lookups. Supports multiple HTTP methods (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE).

key_flow_nodes.node: HTTP Input — accepts all inbound requests on /* or /gateway/*
FlowOrder — sequences audit logging (first) and main processing (second)
Compute (SetAuditParams) — initialises correlation IDs and audit environment
Filter (IsCacheExpired) — checks if routing cache needs refresh
FlowOrder (DBCall) — sequences cache refresh (second) after audit log (first)
Compute (RefreshCache, dataSource=routingdb) — queries routing table into SHARED ROW
SubFlow (RoutingTable) — looks up internal URL and forwards request
HTTP Reply — returns response to caller

structure.name: File_Batch_Processing_Service
structure.description: A batch integration that reads files from a directory, processes each record, calls a backend system, and writes output/audit files.

key_flow_nodes.node: TimeoutNotification — fires at scheduled time (e.g., daily at 07:00)
Compute (ScheduleNext) — sets next run date/time in OutputLocalEnvironment
Compute (FindFiles) — calls Java utility to list files in input directory
Compute (ProcessFile) — reads file, transforms content, calls backend
HTTP Request — calls backend service with transformed payload
MQ Output / File Output — writes results
SubFlow (ErrorHandler) — on any failure, emails alert and logs to system log

property_file_template.description: Template for environment-specific properties files. Replace placeholder values with environment-specific configuration.
property_file_template.content:
# Flow performance settings com.company.esb.MyService_Flow#additionalInstances = 10
# Input node timeout (seconds) com.company.esb.MyService_Flow#HTTPInput.timeoutForClient = 300
# Backend HTTP request timeout (seconds) com.company.esb.MyService_Flow#BackendRequest.timeoutForServer = 120
# Email notification settings (UDP) com.company.esb.MyService_Flow#ErrorHandler_SubFlow.SendMail = YES com.company.esb.MyService_Flow#ErrorHandler_SubFlow.EmailTo = integration-support@example.com com.company.esb.MyService_Flow#ErrorHandler_SubFlow.EmailFrom = esb-monitor com.company.esb.MyService_Flow#ErrorHandler_SubFlow.smtpServer = mailrelay.example.com
